Codex pre-review (not a collaborator review; no marker) @ c00c78208b7aa56911f38b2d0c2ea97a1a719164

Verdict FINDINGS

- PR body:39 — Uses `Refs #763`; the requested `Fixes #` line is missing. Since #763 has later phases, use an appropriate Phase 2 issue rather than closing the umbrella prematurely.
- crates/app/src/operation/selection.rs:228 — This addition grows an already oversized file to 561 lines; frame.rs also grows from 440 to 448. Split along a domain seam to meet the roughly 400-line rule. These size problems predate this PR.

No concrete gouge, crash, or wrong G-code defect found.

Tests: opframe_picks 4/4, opframe_seam 8/8, setup_align 10/10 pass. Quick gate against locally merged upstream/main passes (3.7 min, 0 failures). camcraft-app clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings passes.

Mutations: restoring the selection refusal, reverting selection pose, reverting stitch pose, and passing no setup to stitched_rings each produce an assertion failure (RED). Reverting the selection stamp pose stays GREEN: the existing alignment digest already detects alignment changes. Furniture seam is equivalent to world_facets. Restored opframe_picks passes 4/4; working tree is clean.

Extra safety case: part placement and alignment composition must preserve setup furniture. Inspected the fixture exclusion and unchanged furniture transform; plane_align_edges 5/5, points_align 8/8, and turn_pivot 5/5 pass. No new test code was added.

No changed goldens, snapshot PNGs, PROCESS_VERSION, Cargo dependencies, .github, or scripts in the PR diff. No added production unwrap/expect/panic calls. Changelog is present.
